User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user of the ExamPrep platform.

id.description: Unique identifier for the user entity.

googleId.description: The unique identifier provided by Google for the user.

profileImageUrl.description: URL of the user's profile image (e.g., from Google).

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the user account was created.

Question.title: Question
Question.description: Represents a question for a specific exam, subject, and topic.

id.description: Unique identifier for the question entity.

exam.description: The exam the question belongs to (e.g., JEE, NEET).

subject.description: The subject of the question (e.g., Physics, Chemistry, Biology).

topic.description: The specific topic the question covers (e.g., Kinematics, Thermodynamics).

difficulty.description: The difficulty level of the question (e.g., Easy, Medium, Hard).

options.description: An array of possible answer options for the question.

correctAnswer.description: The correct answer to the question.

solution.description: Detailed step-by-step solution to the question.

year.description: The year the question appeared in the exam.

PracticeSession.title: PracticeSession
PracticeSession.description: Represents a practice session taken by a user.

id.description: Unique identifier for the practice session entity.

exam.description: The exam practiced in the session (e.g., JEE, NEET).

subject.description: The subject practiced in the session (e.g., Physics, Chemistry, Biology).

topic.description: The topic practiced in the session.

startTime.description: Timestamp indicating when the practice session started.

endTime.description: Timestamp indicating when the practice session ended.

score.description: The user's score in the practice session.

totalQuestions.description: The total number of questions in the practice session.

correctAnswers.description: The number of questions answered correctly.

incorrectAnswers.description: The number of questions answered incorrectly.

unansweredQuestions.description: The number of questions left unanswered.

QuestionSession.title: QuestionSession
QuestionSession.description: Represents an individual question session within a practice session.

id.description: Unique identifier for the question session entity.

userAnswer.description: The answer the user selected for the question.

isCorrect.description: Indicates whether the user's answer was correct.

timeTaken.description: The time taken by the user to answer the question (in seconds).

markedForReview.description: Indicates whether the user marked the question for review.

Feedback.title: Feedback
Feedback.description: Represents feedback submitted by a user.

userId.description: The UID of the user who submitted the feedback (if logged in).

userEmail.description: The email of the user who submitted the feedback (if logged in).

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the feedback was submitted.

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore structure is designed to support the ExamPrep platform's core features, focusing on secure user authentication using Google Sign-In and efficient practice session management. Authorization Independence is achieved by storing User IDs directly within PracticeSession documents, eliminating the need for `get()` calls in security rules. Segregation of user data is maintained by nesting PracticeSessions under User documents. This approach provides a robust and easily debuggable security model.

The `users` collection stores user profiles, leveraging the `googleId` for authentication as requested. Practice sessions are stored under user-specific subcollections (`/users/{userId}/practiceSessions/{practiceSessionId}`), ensuring clear ownership and simplifying security rules.  Question sessions are nested under Practice Sessions. The `feedback` collection is a top-level collection to store all user feedback, which can be optionally associated with a user ID.

This structure supports required QAPs by enabling secure `list` operations within the `/users/{userId}/practiceSessions` collection, as only the authenticated user can access their own practice sessions. It also provides a clear and scalable pattern for managing user-specific data.
